name: Healarr
description: Health Evaluation And Library Auto-Recovery for aRR Healarr monitors your media library for corrupted files and automatically triggers re-downloads through Sonarr, Radarr, or Whisparr. It detects issues using ffprobe, MediaInfo, or HandBrake, then orchestrates the complete remediation workflow.

variables.name: Enable Dry Run
variables.description: Enable dry run mode for testing purposes.

variables.name: Retention Days
variables.description: Days to keep old data. 0 to disable.

variables.name: Max Remediation Attempts
variables.description: Maximum number of remediation attempts per item.

variables.name: Verification Timeout
variables.description: Maximum time to wait for file replacement.

variables.name: Internal Port
variables.description: Internal port for the application. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Internal Config Directory
variables.description: Internal config directory for the application. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Internal Database Path
variables.description: Internal database path for the application. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Rate Limit Burst Size
variables.description: Burst size for *arr API rate limiting
